title: Smooth hypercomplex Douady loci of antipodally real finite-degree Cohen-Macaulay curves with acyclic O(-2)-twisted normal sheaf in equidimensional complex spaces over P1
author: Roger Bielawski
work: Hyperkähler Manifolds of Curves in Twistor Spaces
source_version: Official SIGMA 10 (2014) article 033, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2014.033; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The construction identifies the deformation tangent bundle with a tensor product using normal-sheaf cohomology at two fibres. It constructs and proves integrability of the entire projective family of half-dimensional tangent distributions, then uses the antipodal real structure to obtain the canonical hypercomplex structure on the real curve locus, including singular Cohen-Macaulay curves.

source_check.note: The complete original Theorem 3.5 and all preceding author construction and integrability proof are supplied as one main problem unit. Compact pure one-dimensional Cohen-Macaulay curves, finite degree, smooth Douady locus and acyclic normal sheaf twisted by pi-star O(-2) remain the exact domain. The two-fibre normal-sheaf cohomology, deformation tangent tensor-product splitting, projective family of half-dimensional distributions, flow-commutator integrability and antipodal fixed-locus construction are retained in original order. Douady existence, finite-flatness and standard deformation facts remain cited established background. Neither regular embedding nor ambient smoothness is added as a general hypothesis. No hyperkahler metric, later twistor covering or example classification is selected. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: Complete Section3 construction through Theorem3.5 read, with the curve convention and Douady deformation tangent-space definitions of Section2. Curves are compact pure one-dimensional Cohen-Macaulay subspaces, finite-to-one over P1 of constant fibre length d, lying in the smooth Douady locus and with H0,H1 of the normal sheaf tensor pi-star O(-2) equal to zero. The source gives the two cohomology sequences, T X_d=E tensor H and the commutator-of-flows proof of integrability of Q_zeta before taking the sigma-fixed locus. No regular-embedding or ambient smoothness hypothesis is imposed beyond this full source scope. The later pseudo-hyperkahler metric, twistor-Hilbert covering and Hilbert-polynomial examples are excluded.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem3.5 with Section3 standing curve convention: Z pure-dimensional complex space with holomorphic surjection pi to P1 and antiholomorphic involution sigma covering the antipodal map; compact pure1-dimensional Cohen-Macaulay sigma-invariant curves finite-to-one of degree d, in the smooth Douady locus, H0=H1 of N_C/Z tensor pi-star O(-2) zero. If nonempty the locus has canonical hypercomplex structure and real dimension2d(dim Z-1). No automatic hyperkahler metric claimed.
